title: Assert the whole value a UI action is meant to set, not a prefix
rule: When a test checks that an action set a specific value (a filter chip, a chosen option, a label built from an id and a value), assert the full text or attribute derived from the expected value, read from the same source the user picked (the tag, the row). A regex that stops at the field name (`/^Remove filter g storeys /`) passes when the action chose the wrong value. Check that a mutation which picks a different value fails the test.
rationale: E49.10 (#550): the Playwright check for 'find fonts with this' matched only the chip's trait prefix, so a wrong value chosen by findWithTrait would have passed.
